newsitem.title: CHINA: Yizheng rises on hope of possible merger.
newsitem.headline: Yizheng rises on hope of possible merger.

text.p: Shares of Yizheng Chemical Fibre Co Ltd rose on merger hope after the company said its merger plan was being studied by Chinese authorities, brokers said.

"The company making an official statement saying the merger plan is being studied by Chinese authorities gave hope to investors that the merger would become reality soon, and that boosted buying," said a sales manager at regional brokerage.
Yizheng shares rose HK$0.35 or 13.33 percent to HK$2.95 in early trade after they resumed trading on Monday following a two-day trading suspension.
Brokers said they expected the shares to edge up further on following through demand.
Yizheng had said earlier that mainland government authorities were studying a possible merger between the company and other chemical companies.
The merger would involve either one or more of the following companies: Yangzi Petrochemical Corp, Jinling Petrochemical Industrial and Nanjing Chemical Industrial Group.
